description: Main window: open and save dialogs; reading and writing only the files picked in those dialogs (the dialog plugin adds each picked path to the fs scope). A film is written through a file handle (open, seek, write) and removed when its export does not finish. Offline tile packs and « Mes projets »: files under $APPDATA/tiles and $APPDATA/projects only (mkdir, read_dir, exists, rename added, scope limited to those folders; a project is written to a .tmp file then renamed). Native video encoder (system ffmpeg, src/video.rs): its six commands, writing only a file picked in the save dialog. Batch rendering from the command line (src/cli.rs): its two commands; the input and output folders given on the command line are added to the fs scope at startup. Closing the window: a question (message dialog), then destroy once the last write is done (src/ui/library.ts, installCloseGuard). « Importer depuis Strava »: a one-shot listener on 127.0.0.1 for the redirect (oauth plugin), and the system browser opened on https URLs only (opener plugin: the Strava authorization page, and the links of the app that open in a new tab, src/platform/externalLinks.ts).
